entries.name: Bastion · départ léger
entries.brief: A simple close-fitting charcoal ballistic jacket with broad ivory fabric chest and sleeves, compact dull copper shoulder caps, olive work trousers and low practical boots. The head is a short, squared copper protective skullcap with a clearly exposed separate dark-grey dual-filter respirator and two round glass eye lenses, NOT a closed T-visor helmet. Soft waist and unplated thighs, modest beginning equipment. Square chest silhouette, short jacket hem. No knight armor or elaborate full-body plating.

entries.name: Technomancien · départ léger
entries.brief: A dark petrol cropped technical jacket with a broad light-grey shoulder yoke, graphite trousers, plain fabric sleeves and a compact integral harness with two large visible equipment sockets on the chest. A distinctive ROUND high-domed smoked-glass protective face bubble with a low steel rim, small breathing unit below the chin and a short black fabric neck shroud: NOT an angular combat helmet and NOT a T visor. Practical futuristic technician, no building-site overalls, no hardhat, no full plate, no military pauldrons. A few wide orange fabric accents at cuffs and waist. Light and inexpensive starting equipment.

entries.name: Traqueur · départ léger
entries.brief: A narrow cobalt-blue short triangular shoulder poncho over a close-fitting charcoal tactical fabric outfit, a broad sand-grey chest panel and long simple cloth trousers. Low quiet boots with no large shin plates. The head has a snug angular blue cloth hood with a single wide COPPER goggle band across two oval lenses and a folded charcoal face scarf underneath, visibly fabric rather than an armored bucket helmet. Small shoulder width, straight lean lower silhouette, readable short pointed poncho corners and a simple high fabric collar. Modest beginning equipment, no full-body armor, no long cape or backpack.

entries.name: Arcaniste · robe légère de départ
entries.brief: A vivid RED soft-fabric occult robe with a broad black vertical front sash and an ivory throat bib, long straight folded panels ending above simple dark boots. No armored chest, no plated legs, no metallic pauldrons. A tall angular cloth hood with a flat pale ritual mask inside: two narrow VERTICAL black eye openings and an uninterrupted pale lower face, absolutely no horizontal visor or armored T faceplate. Wide loose upper sleeves taper to the common wrists. Broad robe silhouette hides the thighs. A single large angular black ritual motif in the red fabric, without small runes or glow. Humble beginning mage clothing, genuinely a robe rather than repainted tactical armor.

entries.name: Métamorphe · départ organique léger
entries.brief: A simple ochre-olive wrap tunic with a wide folded hem and charcoal fabric trousers, short dark boots and soft sleeves. Sparse ivory curved organic collar and two broad leaf-like shoulder membranes, not metal combat plates. Head completely covered by a smooth elongated IVORY organic face mask, two deep oval vertical eye hollows, no visor, no angular knight jaw, with an irregular olive cloth hood open around its edges. Subtle bone clasp at the waist, spare organic seams on the tunic. A light occult initiate outfit that anticipates the mutation mantle without copying its complete advanced armor, no horned robotic helmet, no cyber superhero plating, no claws or transformation anatomy.

entries.name: Mage · armure moyenne rituelle
entries.brief: A dark INDIGO long split ceremonial coat with a broad IVORY rigid front panel, restrained steel rib guards over its sides and a wide stiff circular collar. No normal military shoulder plates. The head is a round ivory ceremonial protective mask with THREE vertical dark red apertures, enclosed in a shallow round indigo cowl: round dome and round face, no T visor, no pointed hood. Coat lower panels open into two broad geometric tails; charcoal trousers and steel toe caps below. Broad sculptural dark ritual bands, no tiny decoration. A clearly intermediate occult protective outfit, more structured than the light red robe, but not a full combat armor.

entries.name: Combat · armure lourde industrielle
entries.brief: A brutal RED and dark charcoal industrial protective suit: broad one-piece rectangular chest slab, two clearly separated steel shoulder blocks, thick but human-sized cloth elbows, simple squared thigh guards and broad steel boot fronts. The head is a low WIDE rounded industrial helmet with a recessed oval dark viewing window, two thick round side filters and a high mechanical steel collar. No medieval visor, no T face slit and no peaked forehead. Three wide diagonal red-black protective strips on the abdomen, not fine hazard lines. A blocky high-mass chest and wide shoulder silhouette, unmistakably heavy industrial armor rather than a recolored fitted superhero bodysuit. No robot anatomy.

entries.name: Combat · armure très lourde
entries.brief: A massive industrial protective outfit in MUSTARD YELLOW and steel grey, remaining a human wearing armor on the identical anatomical rig. A bulky barrel-shaped chest casing with a very high enclosing collar, broad rounded shoulder shells and thick rectangular shin housings. The small head sits visibly recessed inside the collar under a squat flat dark protective cap, only two small circular ivory viewing lenses visible; no exposed standard helmet shape, no T visor and no angular knight mask. A broad light-steel abdominal panel and graphite flexible joints. Boot housings large and square. Strong barrel silhouette, substantially more protective than the red heavy suit, but hands and joint centers remain unchanged, no stretched limbs or mechanized third limbs.

entries.name: Métamorphe · manteau de mutation
entries.brief: An occult mutation outfit in moss-green and bone-ivory, a short split organic mantle over a flexible charcoal bodysuit, broad leathery overlapping chest and shoulder scales, a high ribbed living collar around a closed dark facemask, a short pointed hood and ivory organic knee shells. All elements clearly blend augmented technology and biological occult mutation. Human untransformed body, not an armored robot or animal. Black articulated gloves and boots; no antenna helmet, huge horns, wings, tail, weapon, aura or transformation.

new_names: Review labels only; no player-facing names or mechanical effects are integrated.
scope: Eight distinct review proposals, five light starts and three progression outfits. Appreciated mutation mantle retained unchanged.
